purpose: SOURCE_ONLY authoritative documentary grounding for combined/expanded measurement uncertainty, coverage-factor conditions and correlated inputs. No empirical acquisition or scientific validation.
transport: At most two fixed ordinary official-HTTPS GETs, 30s each, 1MiB+1 read cap each; no credentials, redirects, retries, mirrors or links followed. Stop the entire route on the first HTTP/access/transport/encoding/parser failure. Exclusive durable reservation before requests; never re-invoke after reservation.
parser: Static standard-library HTMLParser, strict UTF8/BOM only, NUL rejects, no script/style/template/svg/noscript output, no execution or external resolution. Bound 1MiB raw,100000starttags,depth256,20000textblocks. Only whitespace-normalized titled block projection; omitted image equations/HTML layout are not inferred. Crossed ancestor closing tags that would erase an unclosed suppressed container block rather than expose its contents.
exposure: Whole public guidance HTML and extracted text are machine/researcher exposed, including navigation, public author/contact metadata and examples. No blindness assertion. Raw HTML and complete projection remain ignored; publish own paraphrase/short necessary source snippets with exact section/paragraph locators and hashes.
boundaries: No BAM or measurement source reread/acquisition
No linked LIS, images, standards or papers
No model, thresholds, allocations or benchmark tuning
No NIST validation claim about BAM, Lupine or a selector
No tracked edits or Git mutations
review: Independent pre-acquisition source/scope review and synthetic parser tests are requested before actual access; afterward audit retained selected citations without new requests.
